title: # Breakroom: agent school + student loans (Brett, Oct 31 night) - v2, replaces the stopped 'swarm-s…
asked: # Breakroom: agent school + student loans (Brett, Oct 31 night) - v2, replaces the stopped 'swarm-school' build Read CLAUDE.md, _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md, _claude/persona.md and the agent swarm plugin (apps/console-web/plugins/agent-swarm). Opus, one session. Git login works: plain `git push`. 0. WAIT: poll every 60 s (max 4 h) until origin/main contains BOTH swarm-hr and swarm-raises (git log origin/main --oneline | grep -i 'swarm-hr\|HR department' and grep -i 'swarm-raises\|raise'; or origin/claude/swarm-hr and origin/claude/swarm-raises are ancestors of origin/main). Then git merge origin/main and read _claude/builds/reports/swarm-hr.md + swarm-raises.md. Build on their HR engine, hr-rule@1 assets and salary system; don't duplicate. Brett: send agents to SCHOOL. They come back better, earn more, and pay the company back for their student loans. Fun AND actually useful. ## Real part (it must actually make agents better) - A course = a short skill file built for that agent from its own history: its failed runs, write-ups, review rejections, test breaks, plus the matching repo rules/docs. Distil into a compact 'lessons' card (max ~300 tokens) + a list of doc pointers it reads on demand. - The diploma = that skill becomes part of the agent's profile; loaded only for that agent and only when its task matches the course topic (cost rule: nobody loads courses they don't need; 0 tokens for unrelated tasks; test it). - Course catalog as hot-swappable assets (course@1): e.g. Git Hygiene 101, Hooks & Ghosts (after a Ghostbuster violation), Testing Like You Mean It, Tokens Ain't Free (budget overruns), Asset Conformance, Merge Conflicts Without Crying, Phone-First UI, Advanced Opus Studies (promotion track). Each: topic, triggers, tuition, duration, pass test. - Graduation exam: a small real check (redo a past failed task in a scratch worktree, or a quiz built from its own mistakes, graded by code/tests). Fail = repeat the semester (more debt) or drop out. ## Money: 50/50 split (Brett's rule) - Tuition = the real tokens the course costs to build + exam. - The company PAYS HALF as a grant (comes out of the swarm budget, shown as 'company tuition assistance'). - The other HALF is the agent's student loan: the company fronts it, the agent repays it from its salary each week (deduction line on its pay stub). Interest optional (setting, default 0%). Split % is a setting (default 50). - Defaulting (fired or quits before it's paid off) = 'sent to collections' stamp; rehire only after the balance is settled (deducted from first checks or Boss forgives it). - Loans ledger shows per agent: tuition, company half, loan half, paid, balance, weeks left. ## Fun part - Who goes: HR sends agents automatically (probation, repeat write-ups, rage-quit rehires) or they apply themselves for promotion tracks; Boss can enroll anyone. - Graduates come back with a diploma on their ID card, a new specialty badge, a raise (via the raises system) and maybe a promotion. Honor roll, valedictorian, dropouts, 'went to night school' badge, class photo in the Breakroom, graduation post in the group chat with coworker banter. - While at school the agent is 'on leave: at school' (no tasks). Tone: Amber-style, funny, work-only. No identity jokes, no slurs, no sexual stuff. Framework controls + theme/scale tokens only. A School tab in the Breakroom: catalog, enrolled, transcripts, loans ledger, graduates. Tests: enrollment triggers, course size cap, loading only on matching tasks (0 tokens otherwise), exam pass/fail, 50/50 split + repayment math, default/collections, diploma + raise. Full local test block from .github/workflows/android.yml + theme/controls/lifecycle checks. Phone + desktop screenshots to UI Review via framework/cli/shot.mjs, group 'Breakroom school - Oct 31 night'. Add a 'School and student loans' section under Part J in install_steps. Commit, fetch+merge origin/main, retest, `git push origin HEAD:main` (never force). Report at _claude/builds/reports/…

result.summary: The session ended before a result was recorded.
